answer: To blunt sybil swarms, every new agent must first sink a bonded work consignment into a public orchard of time-locked stakes and leave it unspendable for two full epochs. During that wait the consignment is hashed onto a dune of pending proofs that peers re-hash each slot. Only after the bond matures does an atlas of capital lineage publish which mature stakes share a funding parent; siblings under one parent have their grading and vote weight capped as a single unit, so minting many names cannot multiply influence.
